title: A Strawberry Database: Geometric Properties, Images and 3D Scans
notes: Nongtori field Weight_g is measured with the strawberry calyx attached. Therefore Dryad weight_with_calyx is the canonical weight target and weight_without_calyx is auxiliary analysis only. Before APPROVED: audit datasheet columns/units, prove image filename to fruit ID join, require complete with-calyx GT, and split strictly by fruit identity so the 22 views of one berry never cross train/validation/test. Controlled postharvest imagery is suitable for pretraining/geometry baselines, not field-domain acceptance.
